title: The Contest Contract — contestants.yaml registry
description: v1.0. Platform-level registry of competitor lineages. A row is a LINEAGE (claude, suno) — not a specific version. The version that competed in a given contest is pinned at contest-time via the per-contest snapshots: block or the submission frontmatter, not here. See CONTRACT.md §5.

spec_version.description: Which version of the Contest Contract this registry is authored against.

contestants.description: Map keyed by contestant-id. Direct FK lookup from a contest manifest's roster:[..]. Duplicate ids are structurally impossible (object keys).

kind.description: The contestant-kind discriminant. v1.0 ships llm only; others are reserved.

maker.description: Organization that owns the lineage ("Anthropic", "Suno, Inc.").

monogram.description: Two-character glyph for the team tile ("Cl"). Used everywhere a model logo would normally appear.

team_color.description: Hex color used for cards, sparklines, badges. Must be a 6-digit hex.

extensions.description: Kind-specific block. Shape is determined by `kind` (see the allOf branches below).

allOf.$comment: kind: robot extensions (reserved — placeholder, schema admits the kind)

default_access_surface.description: Default surface this lineage competes on ("claude.ai — Max plan"). Per-contest overrides allowed in submission frontmatter.

default_configuration.description: Default mode/tools ("Extended thinking + Web search"). Per-contest overrides allowed.

default_plan_tier.description: Plan/tier the product is competing on ("Pro", "Enterprise").

robotExtensions.$comment: Reserved — placeholder. Real fields land when a robot contest enters planning. Kept loose for now (allows future fields without a schema break).

teamExtensions.$comment: Reserved — placeholder. Real fields land when a team contest enters planning.
